test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been underlined. One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

The __new restaurant__ __on Main Street__ __is cheap than__ __the old one__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'is cheaper than'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence compares the prices of two restaurants.
 
• The correct comparative form of the adjective '**cheap**' is '**cheaper**'.
 
• The phrase "**is cheap than**" is grammatically incorrect because '**cheap**' should be in its comparative form.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be "**is cheaper than**".

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

**Correct Sentence:** *The new restaurant on Main Street **is cheaper than** the old one.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "the older one" - This option changes "the old one" to "the older one" which is unnecessary and does not address the error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "in Main Street" - This option changes "on Main Street" to "in Main Street" which is incorrect usage of prepositions.
 
• **Option 3:** "newer restaurant" - This option changes the subject to "newer restaurant" which is irrelevant to the error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 5:** This option is not a valid correction option as it is the answer indicator.
